BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the B3-1 Community Shopping

District symbols as shown on Map No. 7-J

in the area bounded by:



West Belmont Avenue, a line 106.69 feet west of and parallel to North Central Park

Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West Belmont Avenue; and a line 131.69

feet west of and parallel to North Central Park Avenue.



To those of a B2-2 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District




SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.



Common address of property: 3611 West Belmont Ave., CHICAGO
